## What and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. State skipped checks and why.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe affected consumers, public contracts, migration needs, and remaining risks. Write "None" when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and uses shared behavior rather than scenario-specific branches.
- [ ] Affected consumers, tests, and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Validation matches the risk; performance claims include measurements.
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits and the description is in English.
